title: Add webapp template: .gitignore
description: Create a .gitignore template for the webapp project that excludes node_modules, build outputs, environment files, database files, and system files.

steps.details:
Create src/templates/webapp/.gitignore.tmpl with entries:
node_modules/
dist/
.env
.env.local
.env.production
*.db
*.sqlite
coverage/
.DS_Store
*.log
.vite/
Review the file and confirm both .env and *.db are present — these are the most critical entries to prevent credential and data leaks.

technicalNotes: The .tmpl extension is stripped by the template engine during scaffolding — the file becomes .gitignore in the output
Note: a file named .gitignore in src/templates/ might itself be ignored by git — using .gitignore.tmpl avoids this issue
